summary: Candidate is a distinct safety rule for ProcessPoolExecutor exception handling with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skills cover Virtual WAN routing and BGP configuration (different domain entirely). Peer candidates are related but address different failure modes (deadlock prevention, module importability, ThreadPoolExecutor deadlock) and do not subsume this exception handling rule. The candidate addresses a specific, well-documented failure mode (BrokenProcessPool) with clear intervention moves and constraints that are orthogonal to peer concerns.
